QuestInfo.name: Helping Out Yoona
QuestInfo.0: #bYoona#k is in a bit of trouble after wandering out of Amherst.
QuestInfo.1:
Yoona is trapped by monsters between her and Amherst. To help her return home, she needs you to take care of some #rBlue Snails#k and #rSpores#k.

Blue Snail #r#a10391##k  
Spore #r#a10392##k
QuestInfo.2: You took care of the Blue Snails and Spores and told Yoona.

0.0: Ahhhh! What can I do?! Someone help me! Hey, aren't you a new traveler? Can you...hunt #rBlue Snails#k and #rSpores#k by any chance?

yes.0: I heard Maria was going to pick some mushrooms, so I headed out of town to find her, only to be surrounded by monsters! Please! Take care of #r10 Blue Snails#k and #r10 Spores#k for me! Pretty please!

no.0: Nooooo! What can I do, then? How else can I get home safely?

1.0: Wow! You cleared out the Blue Snails and Spores! That's amazing! Thank you! Now I can safely walk home.

yes.0: If you're looking for Amherst, head west. If you're looking for Southperry, it's southeast of here.

mob.0: I don't think you have defeated all the #rBlue Snails#k and #rSpores#k yet. Please hunt #r10 of each#k for me!
